what: A step list with a vertical line descending from numbered boxes is tied to scroll (Section top at 90% of the screen → bottom at 65%) and drawn in order — for each step, at .38 intervals the number floats up 12px in .4, after .1 the text enters from 16px left in .5, and after .3 the vertical line descends from above in .55 power2.inOut. The last step draws a line that bends from below with a rounded radius of 31.5 and goes right in .65, and the end dot pops out in .35 back.out(2)

options.radius: Corner radius (px) of the curved line, default 31.5
options.[data-fx-part=step]: One step row — contains num (number), body (text), line (vertical line, optional for the last step)
options.[data-fx-part=curve]: (optional) curved-line svg of the last step — the part draws the path inside to fit the cell size (preserveAspectRatio=none)

use:
1. 1
    …
    2. …
  2. 6
    …

from.where: index.js service flow, 6 steps — original homeFlowReveal: p = i×.38, number .4 · text .5 (+.1) · line scaleY .55 power2.inOut (+.3) · curved line dash doubled .65 (+.3) · dot .35 back.out(2) (+.85), top 90% → bottom 65% scrub
